name: After Article 54 (corresponds to Article 71, § 1 in Amendment 2)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the European Defence Industry Programme and a framework of measures to ensure the timely availability and supply of defence products (‘EDIP’)
part_text: Article 54a Continuity of production of crisis-relevant defence products Where Directive 2003/88/EC applies to the relevant production activities, Member States may not decide to use or to encourage economic operators whose production site is located on their territory and which produce the crisis-relevant defence products concerned to make use of derogations provided for in Article 17(3) of Directive 2003/88/EC as this would allow for the expansion of working shifts and constitute serious risks for workers’ and occupational health and safety;
